quests.desc: Welcome to TextWorld! Here is your task for today. First of all, attempt to take a trip north. Then, take a trip east. After that, make an attempt to travel south. Next, attempt to go to the south. If you can accomplish that, head west. Then, go south. With that over with, open the hatch inside the dish-pit. And then, make an attempt to head south. That done, ensure that the gateway is open. After opening the gateway, venture east. With that over with, retrieve the poem from the floor of the lounge. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
